label: Web research
description: Search the public web via Tavily and return ranked snippets for downstream summarize steps

description_i18n.en: Search the public web via Tavily and return ranked snippets for downstream summarize steps
description_i18n.zh_CN: 通过 Tavily 搜索公开网页，返回排序摘要片段供下游摘要
description_i18n.zh_HK: 透過 Tavily 搜尋公開網頁，返回排序摘要片段供下游摘要

propose_guide: Separate step before llm-summarize when NL asks to search the web. Set `query` on the step when NL states a fixed search theme.

propose_guide_i18n.en: Separate step before summarize when NL asks to search the web. Set query when NL states a fixed theme. For deeper bodies use searxng + crawl4ai.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 用户要搜网页时，在摘要前单独一步。有固定主题则设置 query。要全文用 searxng + crawl4ai。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 用戶要搜網頁時，在摘要前單獨一步。有固定主題則設定 query。要全文用 searxng + crawl4ai。

params.name: query
params.description: 搜索关键词；通常来自上一步邮件/任务正文，或在 NL 中写明固定主题
params.example_nl: 根据邮件主题与正文关键词搜索公开资料
params.propose_hint: Set step field `query` when NL names a fixed search theme; otherwise place after email/read step for upstream keywords.

blocked_keywords.label: Blocked keywords
blocked_keywords.description: Reject when content matches any listed substring (case-insensitive).
